itinerary.title: Arrival in Pattaya – Alcazar Cabaret Show
itinerary.description: Welcome to Bangkok International Airport! Upon your arrival, our friendly team will greet you and escort you to your hotel in the vibrant city of Pattaya. After checking in, get ready for a dazzling evening at the renowned Alcazar Cabaret Show. Widely celebrated as Thailand's premier transvestite cabaret, Alcazar has earned global acclaim for its spectacular performances. The show has continually evolved, incorporating innovative stage technology to delight our cherished guests. Enjoy a mesmerising night and rest comfortably at your Pattaya hotel.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Embark on a delightful adventure today as you cruise to the picturesque Coral Island, the grandest among Pattaya's collection of islands. Glide through the azure waters in a speedy boat, marvelling at the breathtaking underwater world through the transparent floor of a classic glass-bottomed boat. Witness an enchanting showcase of sea treasures and vibrant coral formations. Feel the thrill as you take on water activities like Para Sailing, water skiing, and other exciting water sports at your leisure. As the day unfolds, immerse yourself in the beauty of the island before heading back to the cosy comforts of your Pattaya hotel. Overnight stay awaits with memories of an exhilarating day.

itinerary.title: Pattaya - Nong Nooch Village
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before starting on a journey to Nong Nooch Village. This enchanting destination resembles more of a theme park, boasting daily cultural spectacles, charming restaurants, comfortable accommodations, and vast expanses adorned with uniquely themed gardens. The focal point of Nong Nooch Garden is its botanical park, complemented by captivating daily shows at the Thai Cultural Hall. Immerse yourself in the beauty and diversity of this place. Retreat to your hotel in Pattaya for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Bangkok – City Exploration
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to your Pattaya abode as you set forth on a scenic drive to Bangkok. Dive into a mesmerising city and temple tour, highlighted by a visit to the Golden Buddha temple. Marvel at the ancient golden Buddha, a seated figure standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing five and a half tons, dating back to the Sukhothai Period. Next on your itinerary is the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), a contemporary masterpiece of Thai religious architecture. Renowned for its main chapel constructed from exquisite Carara Italian marble, the temple houses a replica of Thailand's most exquisite Buddha image. Check into your hotel in Bangkok for a restful overnight stay. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner (Additional Cost) In the evening, consider enhancing your experience with the optional Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. Glide along the Chao Phraya River, taking in the breathtaking riverside panorama. As you savour a buffet-style dinner, historical temples and landmarks unfold on either side. Delight in live music and dance performances by a professional ensemble, making this dinner cruise a truly memorable experience. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok's Wildlife Wonders
itinerary.description: Kick off the day with a delightful breakfast and get ready for an exciting adventure at Safari World and Marine Park. Dive into the enchanting world of Bangkok Safari, where you'll encounter rare and endangered species up close. The park is divided into two main attractions: Safari Park and Marine Park. Safari Park: Immerse yourself in the closest encounters with the majestic inhabitants of the animal kingdom. Don't miss the awe-inspiring feeding show featuring lions and tigers, a spectacle that stands out as a one-of-a-kind experience worldwide. Marine Park: Enter a realm filled with aquatic wonders, including dolphins, seals, and more. Be captivated by shows featuring talented birds, dolphins, seals, and apes, showcasing their intelligence and skills. As the day winds down, you'll have the evening free to unwind at your leisure. Spend a relaxing night at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Farewell to Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a satisfying breakfast, it's time to bid adieu to the vibrant city of Bangkok. You will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your journey back home or to your next exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Phuket
itinerary.description: When you arrive at Phuket International Airport, someone will be there to meet you and take you to your hotel in Phuket. Once you are at the hotel, you will check in. Phuket is a beautiful place by the Andaman Sea, and it is a popular tropical beach resort. After checking in, you have the rest of the day to relax and do whatever you like. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Phuket. Optional Activity: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner (Extra Cost) The Phuket FantaSea Show, also known as FantaSea of a Kingdom, is like a show you might see in Las Vegas but with a Thai cultural twist. The show represents everything Thai, including love for freedom, fun, courage, and compassion. It takes place in the Palace of the Elephants Theater and tells a mythical story using traditional Thai dance, music, and costumes. There are also colourful special effects, magical illusions, pyrotechnics, and even dancing elephants. The show is suitable for families, and it's a unique and entertaining experience. If you're interested, you can choose to attend this show at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Explore Phi Phi Islands from Phuket
itinerary.description: Begin your day with breakfast. Then, take a ferry to Phi Phi Islands for a tour. Relax on beautiful white beaches, surrounded by impressive cliffs and clear water. Lunch is included. Later in the afternoon, you will return to Phuket and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Travel from Phuket to Pattaya via Bangkok

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you'll hop on a speedy boat to reach Coral Island, the biggest among Pattaya's group of islands. Explore the underwater world and colourful coral formations through a special boat with a see-through bottom. You can also try out exciting water activities like Para Sailing and water skiing. Lunch will be provided, and the rest of the evening is free for you to relax at the hotel in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you'll head to Bangkok and check into your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to spend as you like. You can also choose to take an optional Chao Phraya Cruise with dinner (additional cost). This cruise offers delightful Thai cuisine, entertaining performances, and breathtaking views of the river. As you enjoy a buffet-style dinner, you'll cruise along the river, passing by historic temples and landmarks. A live band and talented singers will keep you entertained throughout the evening.

itinerary.title: Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after having breakfast, you'll explore the city and visit some interesting places. The highlight of our tour is the Golden Buddha temple, where you can see a very old and huge gold Buddha statue. It's 3 metres tall and weighs a whopping five and a half tons. This statue comes from the Sukhothai Period. We'll also stop by the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), which is a modern and famous Thai temple. The main chapel is made of white Italian marble, and inside, you'll find a replica of the most beautiful Buddha image in Thailand. Tonight, you will stay at the hotel in Bangkok. Optional Activity (at an additional cost): Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds If you're interested, you can visit Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, one of the largest aquariums in Southeast Asia. There's a cool Shark Walk where you can see different shark species swimming below you. Madame Tussauds Bangkok is a wax museum where you can see lifelike statues of famous people from around the world, including celebrities, leaders, activists, sports heroes, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Leaving Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a tasty breakfast this morning, you'll be taken to Bangkok International Airport. From there, you can catch your flight back home or to your next exciting destination. Safe travels!

itinerary.title: Arrival In Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Chiang Mai Airport, our representative will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll leave you to refresh, briefly explaining the itinerary and the dos and don’ts of visiting the many temples. Chiang Mai is a beautiful city famous for its unique temples, chedis (stupas), boutique hotels, and night markets. It is also the best place for adventure activities like trekking, river rafting, and visiting the many hill tribes. You are free to explore the city at your leisure before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Your day begins early with a complimentary breakfast buffet at the hotel. Our tour guide will explain in detail the different temple styles and the differences between Thai, Burmese, Lanna, Sri Lankan, and Mon styles. Begin the tour with Wat Phra Singh, one of Chiang Mai’s most revered and oldest temples. You will admire the chedi’s striking Lanna architecture and the Phra Buddha Sihing statue here. Your next stop is Wat Chedi Luang, a 14th-century temple famous for its enormous stupa, which is around 282 feet high and 144 feet wide. The temple, which once held the holy emerald Buddha, one of the most sacred objects in Thailand, was destroyed in an earthquake. You can interact with the monks in the temple and ask questions about Buddha and Buddhism. But do not take their pictures without their permission. The next stop is Wat Suan Dok, a 14th-century temple blending Lanna and Burmese styles. The temple, today, houses relics of Chiang Mai’s royal family. Take a lunch break before moving on to the Chiang Mai Market, the largest and most famous market in Chiang Mai, selling a range of products like shoes, bags, handicrafts, and electronic items.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a scrumptious breakfast buffet at the hotel before proceeding to the Mae Tang Elephant Camp. Some attractions here include elephant shows, elephant rides, ox-cart rides, etc. You will drive through scenic roads and mountains leading up to the camp. Your next stop is the Sankampaeng Area, famous for Thai handicrafts like lacquerware, silverware, and famous Thai umbrellas. Return to the hotel in the evening for an overnight stay at your Chiang Mai hotel.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai to Bangkok
itinerary.description: As usual, begin your day with a breakfast buffet at the hotel. Our tour representatives will transfer you to the Chiang Mai airport to board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s capital. Upon arrival, we’ll take you on a half-day city tour to explore the different temple monasteries like Wat Pho, Wat Trimit, and Wat Benchamabophit. The tour will also explore the famous gems and jewellery stores in and around Bangkok. Here, you can buy semi-precious stones like jade. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Stay overnight at a hotel in Bangkok. Wat Pho is famous for its giant Reclining Buddha statue and the city's largest temples. Wat Traimit is famous for its giant golden statue of Buddha, considered one of the biggest in the world. Wat Benchamabophit, also known as The Marble Temple, was constructed during the 1800s with marble imported all the way from Italy.

itinerary.title: Depart Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, move on to Indra Market to end your tour with some souvenir shopping. Leave Bangkok with beautiful memories of the city and its temples.

itinerary.title: Phuket – FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: As you arrive at the Phuket International Airport, our tour representative will receive you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll explain the itinerary and provide instructions about the dos and don’ts of exploring a traditional Buddhist country and rules regarding respecting the monarchy. Phuket is a beautiful island filled with lush greenery and stunning beaches. Not to mention the scrumptious food in the many street stalls. Some islands in and around Phuket include Koh Phi Phi, Koh Kai Noi, Koh Racha, and Koh Lon. You will explore FantaSea Show, a Thai cultural theme park that best represents Thai culture and tradition. Some of the things you can do at the theme park include souvenir shopping, dinner at the Golden Kinnaree Buffet Restaurant, jewellery shopping at the Iyara Grande, riding elephants on Palace Court, and shopping for tribal art at the Tribal Craft Bazaar. End the day by visiting the local markets. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Phi-Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a scrumptious breakfast with Thai, Indian, and Continental delicacies. For dessert, sample some of their exotic tropical fruits. You will depart Phuket to move on to Phi-Phi Island by ferry. Phi-Phi Island is famous for its beautiful corals and marine life, including leopard sharks and giant manta rays. Tourists also visit the surrounding islands, viz., Koh Mai Pai and Koh Yung. Some attractions in Phi-Phi Island include Maya Bay, Loh Samah Bay, Ko Yao Yai, and Laem Tong Beach. There are plenty of activities on Phi-Phi Island, including snorkelling, swimming with corals and the Finding Nemo snorkelling tour. Spend the night at the hotel, unwinding at one of the many wellness spas.

itinerary.title: Phuket Bangkok Pattaya
itinerary.description: After a scrumptious breakfast, head to Phuket Airport to board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s capital. At the airport, our tour representative will help you take your coach to Pattaya. Pattaya is famous for its beaches, including the beautiful Jomtien Beach and its crazy nightlife. It’s also renowned for its local markets, where you can shop for souvenirs and gawk at the street food stalls selling exotic meat, including grilled snake and crocodile. Don’t miss shopping at the local night markets to buy keychains, fridge magnets, and traditional Thai handicrafts. The Alcazar Show is another attraction and is famous for being the best transvestite cabaret show. Enjoy the show, admiring the art, costumes, and stage design. Spend the night at the hotel, unwinding after a day of fun and activity.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Pattaya, experiencing its history, culture, beaches, and water parks. Some of the unique attractions in Pattaya include: The Sanctuary of Truth – This wooden building is a blend of castle and temple architecture based on Hindu and Buddhist beliefs. Wat Yansangwararam – This large Buddhist temple is a replica of the Mahabodhi Temple in Gaya, India. The temple is famous for its monuments, gardens, lakes, and Chinese pavilions. Some other attractions in Pattaya include swimming, banana riding, and jet ski riding on Coral Island, exploring the different native fishes in Underwater World Pattaya, and visiting the Nong Nooch Tropical Botanical Garden. End your day exploring the different local markets for some souvenir shopping. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Bangkok, Thailand’s capital city. Your tour representative will take you for a half-day city tour, visiting some of the city’s popular attractions. Some of the places covered in the itinerary include: Wat Pho – This is Bangkok's largest and oldest temple, famous for the Reclining Buddha. The temple is older than Bangkok and existed when Thailand was part of the historic city of Ayutthaya. Wat Traimit – The Temple of the Golden Buddha was built in the 18th century, famous for its enormous golden Buddha statue. During the 1950s, it was discovered that the statue was made using solid gold, weighing over 5.5 tons. It is likely 700 to 800 years old. Wat Benchamabophit – This marble temple is made using Italian Carrara marble. It was designed by Prince Narisara Nuvadtivongs using European and Chinese design influences. Other attractions in Bangkok include The Grand Palace, Chatuchak Weekend Market, and Wat Arun. End your day exploring the different local markets for some souvenir shopping. Spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Safari World – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Safari World is Asia’s largest open-air zoo and home to hundreds of animals, including tigers, lions, elephants, and zebras. This drive-in park is split into two experiences. The first experience involves observing the animals in their natural habitat. The second section involves visiting the Marine Park or Water Park. Some of the attractions in the later section include marine life shows, aquarium visits, marine life exhibit visits, bird shows, jungle cruises, animal safaris, elephant shows, and adventure shows.

itinerary.title: Depart Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Indra Market for some last-minute souvenir shopping. Bid goodbye to Thailand and head on to the Bangkok International Market.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui Tour
itinerary.description: Koh Samui is a beautiful island with stunning beaches, waterfalls, temples, and spectacular viewpoints. We’ll help you explore the island and experience its nightlife throughout the tour. The tour will also include sessions at the many wellness spas in and around Koh Samui. Day 2 begins with a hearty breakfast buffet accompanied by exotic tropical fruits. Some of the places we’ll cover include: Grandpa and Grandma Rocks – The Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks are two of the most famous attractions in Koh Samui. These rocks get their name from their shape, which resembles male and female genitalia. Nathon Town – The place is famous for its old-wooden Chinese shops that sell various goods, including clothes, souvenirs, local bath products, coconut oil-based products, and home décor. Na Muang 2 Waterfalls – Na Muang 2 Waterfalls is a set of two waterfalls. While Na Muang 1 is more accessible and crowded, Na Muang 2 is about a 30-minute uphill walk from the first waterfall. Big Buddha Monument – The Big Buddha statue is within the Wat Phra Yai temple. The Buddha statue was built in 1972 and is especially beautiful during sunset. You can enjoy the rest of the day exploring the different local night markets like Bankrak and Chaweng Walking Market. Spend the night at the hotel.

Other places you must visit include The Grand Palace, Wat Arun, and Sea Life. In the evening, you can visit the many local markets like Chatuchak, Or Tor Kor, and Wang Lang to buy silk, jade, coconut oil-based products, trinkets, silver jewellery, and Thai snacks. Spend the night at the hotel.

The highlight of today's exploration is the visit to the Golden Buddha temple, where you will encounter an ancient golden Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres and weighing a staggering five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Following that, you will have the opportunity to marvel at the Marble Temple, also known as Wat Benchamabophit. This temple stands as a modern gem in Thai religious architecture. Its main chapel, constructed in elegant white Carara Italian marble, is home to a replica of Thailand's most exquisite Buddha image. The Marble Temple is a must-visit for its serene beauty and cultural significance. After a day of exploration, unwind and spend the night at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: Indulge in a delicious breakfast to kick-start your final day in Bangkok. Post-breakfast, you will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport, marking the end of your memorable journey. Safe travel!

itinerary.title: Arrive in Phuket – Phuket FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Phuket International Airport, our tour representative will welcome you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Phuket is a stunning island with breathtaking scenery. It is Thailand’s largest island and is named after the Malay word "Bukit." Phuket offers plenty of tourist attractions, including Chinese-Portuguese architecture, stunning beaches, street food options, diverse cuisine, and diverse activities. In the evening, enjoy cultural performances and Las Vegas-style shows at the Phuket FantaSea. Spend the night at the Phuket beach resort.

itinerary.title: Phuket-Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Board the Express Boat to Phi Phi Island. Explore the beautiful sights of Maya Bay and have a great time. If you're into snorkelling or the underwater world, the tour representative can take you to Coral Bay for swimming and spotting Nemo at Snorkeling Point. Have lunch and return to Phuket for an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Bangkok to Pattaya
itinerary.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast and head to Phuket Airport. Catch a flight to Bangkok. Once you land at Bangkok International Airport, our tour representatives will be there to assist you. You'll then be transferred to Pattaya by coach. This charming city is situated on the east coast of the Gulf of Thailand, boasting beautiful sandy beaches, great shopping, and captivating tourist attractions. Originally a fishing town, Pattaya has transformed into one of Thailand's top tourist destinations. Upon reaching Pattaya, relax at the hotel for a bit. In the evening, attend the Alcazar show, also known as the Tiffany Show. This show is a delightful combination of art, costumes, and stage design. Enjoy the musical performance and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya
itinerary.description: Have your breakfast at the hotel. Prepare to explore the coral island with our tour representatives. Experience the vibrant coral and underwater world through a glass-bottom boat. Later, engage in watersports like sunbathing, water scooting, parasailing, snorkelling, and more. Enjoy your time here and return to the city for some shopping. In the evening, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok - Departure
itinerary.description: After a quick breakfast, visit Indhira Market for shopping. In the evening, our tour guide will take you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Koh Samui
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Koh Samui Island, our tour manager will welcome you and help you to transfer to the hotel. Complete check-in and spend the rest of the day exploring places in and around your resort. You could visit the neighbouring towns of Mae Nam and Choeng Mon to enjoy the pristine beaches or shop at one of the local markets. In the evening, head to the adjacent island of Koh Phangan to explore the natural corals on the island. Ko Phangan is famous for its Full Moon Party, an all-night party held on full moon nights every month. Return to the resort in the evening to spend your night in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will explore the island of Koh Samui. This island is famous for its pristine beaches, lush tropical rainforests, and world-class spas. You will cover Koh Samui’s attractions, including Wat Phra Yai, Ladd Koh, and Wat Kunaram. Don’t miss the Hin Ta and Hin Yai or, Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks, and the Tarnim Magic Garden. Spend the night in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui – Phuket
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will check out of the hotel to catch your flight to Phuket. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and enjoy the island and its views. Thailand’s largest island, Phuket, is known for its vibrant nightlife and white sandy beaches. You will explore some of Phuket’s tourist attractions. Some of the places you will enjoy today (or tomorrow, depending on time) are FantaSea, the Big Buddha, and Green Elephant Sanctuary Park. Spend the night in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Phi Phi Island
itinerary.description: Some of the top attractions you will cover today include Old Phuket Town, Freedom Beach, Monkey Hill, Kata Beach, Kamala Beach, Wat Chalong, Nai Harn Beach, and Karon Viewpoint. Later, head to Phi Phi Island to visit Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, Bamboo Island, and Viking Caves. Return to your hotel in Phuket for the night.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Bangkok
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel to catch your return flight to Bangkok. Later in the night, you will catch your return flight to India.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Koh Samui
itinerary.description: Your journey begins with your arrival at Koh Samui airport. A warm greeting awaits you, and you'll be smoothly transported to your hotel in Koh Samui. Take a moment to settle in and check into your accommodation. The evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and unwind as you prepare for the exciting days ahead. Overnight stay at your chosen hotel in Koh Samui.

itinerary.title: Discover Koh Samui with a City Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then set off on a captivating Koh Samui City Tour. Immerse yourself in the island's rich culture as you visit its main attractions. This full-day exploration promises to unveil the beauty and charm of Koh Samui. After an exciting day of discovery, return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui - Ang Thong National Park
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and get ready to explore the enchanting Ang Thong, a marine national park nestled in the Gulf of Thailand within Surat Thani Province. This paradise comprises 42 stunning islands. After a day of discovery, retreat to your comfortable accommodation in Koh Samui for a restful night.

itinerary.title: Koh Samui - Bangkok
itinerary.description: After a splendid breakfast, bid farewell to your Koh Samui haven as you check out and head to Koh Samui Airport. Board your flight bound for Bangkok International Airport, where a warm welcome awaits. Transfer to your chosen hotel in the vibrant city of Bangkok, where you'll spend the night. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya Cruise – No Dinner (Additional Cost) For an extra touch of magic, consider the optional Chao Phraya Cruise with no dinner (available at an additional cost). Revel in the beauty of Thai cuisine, engaging entertainment, and breathtaking river panoramas. As you embark on this dinner cruise, let the historic temples and landmarks along the riverbanks captivate you. A buffet-style dinner, accompanied by a live band and talented singers, guarantees an unforgettable evening. Alternatively, you can upgrade to the Chao Phraya Cruise with dinner, adding a culinary dimension to your cruise experience. Immerse yourself in the splendour of the riverside scenery while indulging in a delectable feast.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok's Rich Heritage
itinerary.description: Embark on a fascinating journey through the heart of Bangkok as you delve into the city's temples and cultural treasures. A major highlight awaits you at the Golden Buddha temple, where an ancient gold Buddha, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing five and a half tons, resides. This magnificent, seated image, dating back to the Sukhothai Period, is a true marvel. Next on the itinerary is a visit to the Marble Temple, or Wat Benchamabophit, a masterpiece of modern Thai religious architecture. The temple's main chapel, crafted from exquisite white Carrara Italian marble, houses a replica of Thailand's most beautiful Buddha image. Immerse yourself in the serenity and beauty of this iconic site. Overnight, find comfort at your hotel in Bangkok. Optional Excursion: For those seeking extra thrills, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World (formerly Siam Ocean World), one of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums. Experience the innovative Shark Walk, where, instead of walking through an acrylic tunnel, you stroll above a tank teeming with five species of sharks. Alternatively, venture into the captivating world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a wax museum that brings you face-to-face with world celebrities, leaders, sports icons, artists, and even royalty. (Additional cost applies)

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, bidding farewell to the vibrant city of Bangkok. After checking out from your hotel, you will be seamlessly transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your flight home or to your next exciting destination.

packages.name: Singapore with Thailand
packages.destination: Singapore - Sentosa Island - Bangkok - Pattaya - Coral Island

itinerary.title: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
itinerary.description: As soon as you land at Changi Airport, our tour representative will greet you and take you to the hotel. We’ll leave you to check in and rest before proceeding to the first activity – the Night Safari on the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. This open-air zoo is the first of its kind and is home to thousands of animals.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour
itinerary.description: The second day begins with exploring the different tourist attractions in the city, namely, Gardens By The Bay, a nature park spread over 101 hectares; the National Gallery, a museum showcasing Southeast Asian art collections; the Merlion Park, famous for the Merlion Statue, a half-lion and half-fish statue. Some other places covered in the tour include the Esplanade Theatre, Suntec City, and Marina Bay. You’ll also visit the Indian National Army Monument in downtown Singapore built in 1995 to honour the brave INA soldiers who died fighting the British in India and Burma, and the Singapore Zoo, which is home to over 2,800 animals.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island – Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Check out from the city hotel to transfer to Sentosa Island. You’ll begin your adventure with Universal Studios, Southeast Asia's first and only Universal Studios theme park. The park is famous for its amazing rides, games, and interactive shows based on old Hollywood movies like Jurassic Park, Madagascar and Shrek.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
itinerary.description: The next day you can enjoy the remaining attractions on Sentosa Island. There are over 25 attractions, ranging from SEA Aquarium and Adventure Cove Waterpark to Madame Tussauds and Palawan Beach. You can also experience the cable car ride from Mount Faber to Sentosa Island or enjoy Skyline Luge and Skyride, an open-air cart drive for a majestic view of the island.

itinerary.title: Singapore – Pattaya - Big Buddha Temple - Dolphin World
itinerary.description: On your fifth day, board your flight from Singapore to Bangkok. Our tour representatives will meet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel in Pattaya. The first destination in Pattaya is the Big Buddha Temple, where Buddha's idol stands at 300 feet. After witnessing this spiritually rich spot, you can head for a dolphin show at Dolphin World, which kids will surely enjoy.

itinerary.title: Coral Island - Night Bazaar
itinerary.description: On Day 6, take a speedboat to explore the scenic Coral Island, the largest island in Pattaya and one of the most visited tourist attractions. You can stroll with your loved one on the island’s golden beaches or engage in parasailing, snorkelling, banana boat riding and other water-based activities. You can end your day by visiting Pattaya’s popular Night Bazaar, a famous street market selling clothes, accessories, and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Begin your day by driving from Pattaya to Bangkok. You can enjoy the rest of the day at leisure or go for a cruise on the Chao Phraya River to enjoy dinner, dance, and live music. The Chao Phraya River Cruise offers a memorable view of the riverside scenery, where you can admire the beautiful temples and landmarks. And to finish the day attend a Cabaret Show to experience glitz and glamour.

itinerary.title: Bangkok City Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the power and magnificence of Thai Royalty early in the day by visiting the Grand Palace, where the King of Thailand resides. The Golden Buddha Temple is another highlight of the day, famous for its seated Buddha that weighs five and a half tons and is from the Sukhothai period. Don’t miss Wat Pho, the reclining Buddha temple famous for its 15 metres tall and 46 metres long Buddha. The soles of this Buddha are crafted with mother-of-pearl shells. Drink in the serenity and peace at Wat Arun, the Temple of the Dawn, one of Thailand’s oldest and most famous temples.

itinerary.title: Depart from Bangkok
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Bangkok to Krabi City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Bangkok Airport, catch a flight to Krabi. Once you reach Krabi Airport, a transfer will take you to the hotel. Take some time to relax at the hotel. Enjoy your stay in Krabi with ample free time for personal activities. In the afternoon, embark on a city tour of Krabi to see some of the main tourist spots. Afterward, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi - Four Island Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Our tour representatives will guide you on a city tour to explore this beautiful island. If you love the sea and sun, then Krabi is the perfect destination for you. It's a captivating place squeezed into a small province. The main activities here include swimming, photography, sunbathing, snorkelling, and more. Have a fantastic time in the crystal-clear waters, under the sun, on the white powdery sand beaches surrounded by coconut palms. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Phi-Phi Island Tour to Phuket
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Travel to Phi-Phi Island via an Express Boat. Once on the island, relish sightseeing at Maya Bay and have a fantastic time exploring. If you fancy snorkeling or the underwater world, the tour representative will take you to Coral Bay for a swim and an opportunity to find Nemo at Snorkeling Point. Have your lunch and proceed to Phuket. Enjoy your overnight stay at the Phuket Hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket - FantaSea Show
itinerary.description: After having your morning breakfast, get ready to explore Phuket city on your own. The name "Phuket" comes from the Malay word meaning "Hill." It's the largest island in Thailand, situated in the Andaman Sea. Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, our tour representatives will welcome you and transfer you to a beach resort for the rest of the day. In the evening, enjoy the FantaSea Show, then return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket Departure
itinerary.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, you have the entire day at your leisure or can venture out. In the evening, we will take you to Phuket International Airport for your flight departure.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Phuket
itinerary.description: As you land at the vibrant Phuket International Airport, a warm greeting awaits you. Your journey begins with a seamless transfer to your chosen hotel in the heart of Phuket. Immerse yourself in the check-in process, settling into a haven that rests along the stunning Andaman Sea-a true gem and a beloved tropical beach resort. The remainder of the day is yours to embrace at your own pace. Feel the inviting embrace of the sun-soaked beaches or explore the local charm that Phuket has to offer. Your overnight stay at the hotel promises comfort and tranquillity. For those seeking a touch of spectacle, an optional adventure awaits. Consider the mesmerising Phuket FantaSea Show-an enchanting display of Thai culture with a Las Vegas flair. Hosted in the grand Palace of the Elephants Theater, this family-friendly performance weaves together traditional Thai dance, captivating music, and vibrant costumes. Brace yourself for a mythical journey enriched with special effects, magical illusions, pyrotechnics, and the graceful presence of dancing elephants. (Optional Tour: Phuket FantaSea Show – No Dinner, available at an additional cost). Set off on this delightful journey into the heart of Phuket, where each moment unfolds like a beautifully crafted story.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Phi Phi Island Excursion
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast, followed by an exciting adventure to Phi Phi Island. Board a ferry and embark on a journey to this stunning destination, where classic white beaches meet impressive limestone cliffs, and crystal-clear waters sparkle in the sunlight. Spend the day basking in the beauty of your surroundings. In the late afternoon, return to Phuket and unwind at your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket - Bangkok
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Phuket International Airport to catch your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in the city. Check in and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. Overnight stay at the hotel. (Optional: Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner at an additional cost) In the evening, consider treating yourself to a magical experience with the Chao Phraya River Cruise Dinner. Glide along the Chao Phraya River, indulging in a sumptuous buffet dinner while enjoying live music and dance performances. Marvel at the historic temples and landmarks lining the riverbanks as you create lasting memories on this beautiful cruise.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bangkok – City Tour
itinerary.description: Kickstart the day with a splendid breakfast. Today you will delve into the heart of Bangkok for a captivating temple and city tour. The crowning jewel of our expedition is the visit to the Golden Buddha temple, housing an ancient gold Buddha. This seated masterpiece, standing at an impressive 3 metres tall and weighing a remarkable five and a half tons, dates back to the Sukhothai Period. Our exploration continues to the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), an epitome of contemporary Thai religious architecture. Renowned for its main chapel constructed from exquisite white Carara Italian marble, this temple proudly displays a replica of Thailand's most beautiful Buddha image. The overnight stay at the hotel in Bangkok promises a tranquil end to an enriching day. Optional: Immerse in Aquatic Wonders & Celebrity Encounters (Additional Cost) For those seeking extra thrills, consider a visit to Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, formerly known as Siam Ocean World, Southeast Asia's biggest aquarium. Highlights include the innovative Shark Walk, where visitors stroll above a tank inhabited by five species of sharks, providing a unique perspective. Alternatively, delve into the enchanting world of Madame Tussauds Bangkok, a wax museum that promises entertainment and encounters with lifelike figures of world celebrities, heads of state, activists, sports icons, legendary artists, and even royalty.

itinerary.title: Departing Bangkok
itinerary.description: As the sun rises on a new day, relish a leisurely breakfast before bidding adieu to the vibrant city of Bangkok. A transfer awaits to escort you to Bangkok International Airport, where you will board your flight back home or to your next exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Chiang Mai
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Chiang Mai International Airport, our tour representative will welcome you and help you transfer to the hotel. We’ll brief you about the tour and explain the etiquette to be followed in the religious places. Chiang Mai is a beautiful city famous for its handicrafts, including silverware, lacquerware, woodwork, and umbrellas. But what makes it even more special is the city’s ancient and unique temples. When in Chiang Mai, don’t miss the beautiful temples, chedis, boutique hotels, and local night markets. It is also an excellent place for adventure lovers with a range of activities, including ziplining, river rafting, camping, trekking, and ATV riding. Spend the day enjoying the city at your leisure and stay overnight at a Chiang Mai hotel.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the buffet. Your first stop for the day is Wat Chedi Luang, a 14th-century temple famous for its enormous Buddhist chedi, built in the Lanna architecture. Some of the other temples included in the Chiang Mai Temple Tour include: Wat Phra Singh – This 14th-century temple has a distinct Lanna architecture but is also influenced by neighbouring Burmese and Sri Lankan architecture. The temple is also famous for its intricate art, including sculptures, doors, windows, and panels. Wat Suan Dok – Also called Wat Buppharam, this 14th-century temple features Lanna-style architecture and houses a 500-year-old bronze statue of Buddha. And if you’re at the right time, don’t miss the annual temple fair held in June every year. After the Chiang Mai Temple Tour, we’ll conclude the day with a visit to the Chiang Mai market, which is famous for Thai handicrafts, including clothes, souvenirs, and jewellery.

itinerary.title: Chiang Mai To Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll catch your flight to Bangkok, but not before sampling a scrumptious breakfast buffet featuring Indian, Thai, and Continental delicacies. And, of course, a huge range of exotic tropical fruits. As soon as you land in Bangkok, our tour representatives will help you check in to the hotel. Later, we’ll take you on a half-day tour of the city, covering a range of attractions, viz., the Wat Pho Temple, Wat Traimit Temple, and Wat Benchamabophit. You’ll end the day with some jade and souvenir shopping at Bangkok's many gem and jewellery shops. Spend the night at a Bangkok luxury hotel.

itinerary.title: Safari World – Bangkok
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Safari World, a 200-acre open-air zoo. This is Asia’s largest open-air zoo, home to various animals and birds, including tigers, lions, and zebras. You mustn’t miss the zoo’s marine park, famous for its life shows, aquarium, and adventure zone. Some of the activities in Safari World include under-the-sea experiences, jungle cruise river tours, jungle walks, and orang-utan shows, sea lion shows, and dolphin shows. Spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Departure
itinerary.description: On the last day of your tour, we’ll take you to Indra Market to complete your shopping. Later, end the day with a return flight to India from the Bangkok International Airport.
